description: Every version, source and digest this environment is pinned to. prepare-host verifies each one and refuses to continue when a digest does not match.

pulumi_cli.backend: file:// (pulumi login --local); Pulumi Cloud is never used

packer.note: already present on the development host; the template pins the qemu plugin itself

base_image.kind: cloud image for qemu and libvirt, not a container image

tool_image.built_by: packer, qemu builder, from the base image above

orca.note: the amd64 package only; the rpm is never installed alongside it

claude_code.note: installed from the registry at the pinned version, never at latest

skills.note: see the top-level skills block; every entry is pinned and verified inside the environment before the task runs

node.note: Ubuntu packages node 18, on which the skills command line fails with a module error; this tarball is unpacked into /usr/local/node after its digest is checked

excludes: any part of the host home directory

project_source.description: The checkout the runner exports a revision from. The revision under test is named by the run configuration, never here: the evaluation harness and the revision it tests stay separate, so any branch can be tested without merging it into this one.

skills.description: What the agent inside the environment must be able to reach. Each entry is pinned, and the runner asks the environment for the digest rather than trusting that an install succeeded.

bundled.why_a_digest: the install resolves to `npx skills add <repo>`, which fetches what is current; the digest is what tells that apart from what was pinned

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.note: cloned and checked out at the commit above, then added as a marketplace and installed; a tag would move

cloud.why: this cycle reaches no cloud service. Pulumi runs on the host, not inside the environment, so the environment needs no cloud skill. A test that does use one adds it here, pinned like the rest.
